recipes.name: Quadruple Stacked Ham Sandwich inspired by Final Fantasy XV
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
4 slices rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread
4 slices whole wheat round sandwich bread
2 slices toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread
For the Ham & Sweet Potato (Second) Sandwich
4 1/2 slices thick cut Black Forest deli ham
3 1/2 slices cooked sweet potato or sweet potato chips
For the Shredded Lettuce & Honey Ham (Third) Sandwich
2 slices toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread
2 slices toasted round whole wheat sandwich bread
1 whole round sourdough, french, or Italian bread loaf
thick cut Black Forest ham slices
instructions: For Quadruple Stacked Ham Sandwich :
For the Prep
Peel the sweet potatoes before thinly slicing the eggplant, tomatoes, and sweet potatoes. - 1 eggplant thinly sliced - 3 small tomatoes thinly sliced - 2 sweet potatoes peeled and thinly sliced
Preheat the oven to 350°F and set a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet.

Transfer the sweet potato slices to the prepared baking sheet and sprinkle with a pinch of kosher salt. Then, transfer to the preheated oven and cook for about 10 minutes. - 2 sweet potatoes peeled and thinly sliced - pinch of salt
Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, combine eggplant slices and a handful of cornstarch, making sure it’s evenly distributed throughout. - 1 eggplant thinly sliced - 2 tbsp cornstarch as needed
Then, add about a half-inch of neutral oil to a sauté pan over medium heat. - neutral cooking oil as needed
Meanwhile, line a baking sheet with paper towels for draining.

Once the oil begins to smoke a bit, transfer the coated eggplant slices to the oil. Fry for about 2 minutes per side or until the eggplant slices are golden brown. - 1 eggplant thinly sliced - neutral cooking oil as needed
Transfer the fried eggplant slices to the prepared baking sheet to drain and remove excess oil. - 1 eggplant thinly sliced
Remove the sweet potato slices from the oven and set aside for later use. - 2 sweet potatoes peeled and thinly sliced
In a saucepan over medium heat, combine equal parts oyster sauce, soy sauce, rice, vinegar, and sugar. - 2 tbsp oyster sauce - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 2 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tbsp granulated sugar
Stir to reduce until just sticky, then add the fried eggplant slices to the glaze, stirring to ensure even coverage. Set aside for later use. - 1 eggplant thinly sliced
For the Scampi Shrimp
In a sauté pan over medium high heat, combine butter, garlic, and chili flakes. Stir until bubbly. - 2 tbsp butter - 2 cloves minced garlic - 1 tsp chili flakes
Then, add shrimp with a sprinkling of salt and the lemon juice. - 1 lb shrimp - salt to taste - 2 tbsp (1/2 lemon) juiced
Fully cook the shrimp in the garlic mixture, about 2 minutes per side or until the shrimp is pink. Transfer to a plate and set aside for later use. - For the Scampi Shrimp
For the Bread

Preheat the oven to 375°F and prepare a baking sheet with a wire rack and place all 8 slices of sandwich bread on the rack. - 4 slices rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread - 4 slices whole wheat round sandwich bread
Toast in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes or until nice and toasty. - 4 slices rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread - 4 slices whole wheat round sandwich bread
Remove from the oven and set aside for the Sandwich Assembly. - For the Bread
For the Toppings
Meanwhile, very carefully peel the shell from the avocados, keeping the inside intact. - 1 ½ avocados peeled & sliced
Halve and remove the pits, then brush with freshly squeezed lemon to prevent oxidation. - 1 ½ avocados peeled & sliced - 2 tbsp lemon juice
Then, slice the avocadoes into thin rings, about ¼ inch thick. - 1 ½ avocados peeled & sliced
Set aside for later use.
For the Assembly
For the 1st Sandwich

Begin with 2 slices of the toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread. Layer a bed of thin avocado rings on the bottom slice. - 2 slices toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread - avocado rings
Then, follow with a pile of the glazed fried eggplant slices, and finally the sliced tomatoes topped with a leaf of lettuce. - glazed fried eggplant slices - leaf of lettuce - sliced tomatoes
Top with the 2nd slice of the toasted rectangular bread and secure with a toothpick. - 2 slices toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread
Set aside for the Final Sandwich Assembly. - For the Eggplant (First) Sandwich
For the 2nd Sandwich
Slice a whole loaf of Ciabatta. - Ciabatta loaf sliced
In a small bowl, combine Dijon mustard, mayo, and lemon juice and whisk until homogenous. - 4 tbsp Dijon mustard - 4 tbsp mayo - 2 tbsp lemon juice
Begin by spreading a generous layer of the Mustard Mixture on both slices of bread. - Ciabatta loaf sliced - Mustard mixture
Then, top with lettuce. - 2 ½ leaves of lettuce
Follow up with Black Forest deli ham, layering in a ribbon-like fashion atop the lettuce for game accuracy. - 4 ½ slices thick cut Black Forest deli ham
Use toothpicks to secure the ham and lettuce to the bread
Add another bed of lettuce then cooked sweet potato slices or baked sweet potato chips, and layer atop of the lettuce. - 2 ½ leaves of lettuce - 3 ½ slices cooked sweet potato or sweet potato chips
Finish with the top slice and secure with toothpicks. - Ciabatta loaf sliced
Set aside for the Final Sandwich Assembly. - For the Ham & Sweet Potato (Second) Sandwich
For the Third Sandwich
Begin with the last 2 slices of the toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread, and layer with mustard mixture. - 2 slices toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread - Mustard mixture
Follow with a bed of lettuce on the bottom slice. - 2 ½ leaves of lettuce
Then, add a ribbony bed of the honey ham folded in a rectangular shape. - 4 slices honey ham

Thinly slice a head of lettuce into shreds, salt, and transfer to the sandwich on top of the honey ham, finally topping with the final slice of toasted rectangular sandwich bread. - 1 head of lettuce shredded - salt as needed - shredded lettuce - 2 slices toasted rectangular whole wheat sandwich bread
Secure with toothpicks and set aside for the Final Sandwich Assembly. - For the Shredded Lettuce & Honey Ham (Third) Sandwich
For the 4th Sandwich

Begin with the toasted round whole wheat sandwich bread slices and add a layer of tomato slices followed by a pile of avocado rings. - 2 slices toasted round whole wheat sandwich bread - sliced tomatoes - avocado rings
Then, add a layer of the garlic butter scampi shrimp and one more layer of avocado rings. - garlic butter scampi shrimp - avocado rings
Top with the second slice of round whole wheat sandwich bread. - 2 slices toasted round whole wheat sandwich bread
Secure with toothpicks and prepare for the Final Sandwich Assembly. - For the Shrimp & Avocado (Fourth) Sandwich
For the Final Sandwich Assembly

Starting from the base, begin with the Eggplant Sandwich (1st) followed by the Ham & Sweet Potato Sandwich (2nd), then layer the Shredded Lettuce & Honey Ham Sandwich (3rd), carefully using the toothpicks to secure each layered sandwich, finally finish with the Shrimp & Avocado Sandwich. - For the Eggplant (First) Sandwich - For the Ham & Sweet Potato (Second) Sandwich - For the Shredded Lettuce & Honey Ham (Third) Sandwich - For the Shrimp & Avocado (Fourth) Sandwich
Use a long, wooden cooking skewer or dowel to secure all 4 sandwiches and garnish with 1 green olive. - 1 green olive to garnish
For the Serving
It’s likely slicing the sandwich will be difficult, so feel free to disassemble the sandwich into its 4 parts to share amongst friends! You’ll have plenty of leftovers.
For The Shooter-Style Ham Sandwich or Stacked Ham Sandwich Bread Bowl:

Using a whole round bread loaf, slice off the top of the loaf (reserve) and scoop out the soft insides, leaving a hollow but sturdy bread bowl, and reserving the breadcrumbs for any croutons or breadcrumbs you’d like to make. - 1 whole round sourdough french, or Italian bread loaf

Begging by layer all ingredients from the Stacked Ham Sandwich in the bowl, compressing as you go: avocado rings, followed by lemon juice, glazed fried eggplant slices, tomato slices, thick-cut Black Forest ham slices, sweet potato slices, American cheese slices, another layer of avocado rings, scampi shrimp, and one final layer of tomato slices. - avocado rings - lemon juice - glazed fried eggplant slices - tomato slices - thick cut Black Forest ham slices - sweet potato slices - American cheese slices - shrimp
Finalize with a thin layer of the mustard mixture on the bottom of the removed loaf top, and return the top to the bread bowl. - mustard mixture
Preheat the oven to 350°F and wrap the entire assembled bread bowl in aluminum foil.
Transfer to the oven and cook for 10 to 15 minutes

After time has elapsed, remove from the oven and compress the sandwich by weighing down the warmed and wrapped sandwich with a flat piece of cardboard and some heavy items like a Dutch oven and/or a few Babish cookbooks for an hour.
Unwrap and slice, checking out the beautifully layered cross section.
Serve immediately and share with friends! You’ll have plenty of leftovers.
